header.title: Engineered Strain Sample Schema
header.description: Engineered Strain Schema for the AnalysisAPI

sample_name.title: sample name
sample_name.description: The name or label that is present on the shipped sample. This should be a human readable name.

strain_name.title: strain name
strain_name.description: Provide a unique name to identify transformed strain lines.

other.title: other
other.description: Other/additional details about your sample that you feel can't be accurately represented in ANY of the available columns.

storage_condt.title: storage condition
storage_condt.description: The storage condition of the sample. This field is NOT multivalued. If selecting other, add the `other_storage_condt` attribute to provide additional detail.

other_storage_condt.title: storage condition other
other_storage_condt.description: Please specify your storage conditions if 'other' and the available values are not appropriate

samp_store_temp.title: sample storage temperature
samp_store_temp.description: The temperature at which your samples should be stored upon arrival. This field is NOT multivalued. If selecting other, add the `other_samp_store_temp` attribute to provide additional detail.

strain_source.title: strain source
strain_source.description: Indicate the source of the strain provided. If purchased provide the vendor and lot number, if from another registered or known strain provide a reference.

cbi.title: confidential business information
cbi.description: Indicate if any information about the strain is considered confidential business information

organism_name.title: organism name
organism_name.description: Provide the scientific name (genus and species) of the host organism.

modification_method.title: modification method
modification_method.description: Select the method used to insert your construct into the genome of your modified organism

strain_description.title: strain description
strain_description.description: A brief description of the modifications that comprise this strain

trait.title: trait
trait.description: Select the general type of intended trait

phenotype.title: phenotype
phenotype.description: Provide the intended phenotype of the modified organism.

genotype_segment_category.title: genotype segment category
genotype_segment_category.description: Select the genotype category. A genotype is generally an expression cassett or a grouping of genetic elements or a gene edit containing a set of construct components leading to one or more intended traits. A strain may consist of multiple genotypes.

genotype_segment_name.title: genotype segment name
genotype_segment_name.description: Provide a name that describes the genotype modification engineered relative to the reference, unmodified genome. The name should describe the spatially grouped components or specific function of the modification.

component_name.title: construct component name
component_name.description: Provide a one-to-three word name based on the component. If using an acronym, provide the full component name in the component description.

donor_organism.title: donor organism
donor_organism.description: Provide the scientific name (genus and species) of the organism from which the construct component was first described or obtained. You may enter 'synthetic' if relevant.

component_description.title: construct component description
component_description.description: Provide a short statement describing the function of the construct component. You may provide an optional literature reference for lesser-known components.

shipped_sample_size.title: shipped sample size
shipped_sample_size.description: Total amount of sample sent to EMSL. Must include units.

collection_date.title: collection date
collection_date.description: The date of sampling as an instance. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Also valid, if entire collection date is unknown is just year (YYYY) or just year and month (YYYY-MM)
